title: Rioproperty
description: Warm paper white with deep indigo headings, plain grey body copy and an electric violet brand; lavender and lemon yellow appear only on violet or indigo. A wide geometric display grotesk in uppercase at one heavy weight over Rubik; square corners, completely flat.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling with the deep indigo as the page
secondary is the deep indigo footer band; accent is the lavender used as quiet text on violet; highlight is the lemon yellow
muted-foreground is the grey of body copy, foreground the indigo of headings
page-gutter and section-y are fluid clamps (19px→60px, 84px→120px)
name: rioproperty-theme
